platform: Linux arm64 Docker on macOS, shared host without CPU pinning; Rust 1.90 release, thin LTO.
method: Same benchmark driver compiled against immutable before source and modified after source. Before binary copied out; modified package explicitly cleaned/rebuilt to prevent shared-target reuse. Identity checks distinguish baseline diagnostics from exact two-pass streaming byte count.
applicability: Native recording/storage validation and prefix recovery only. Supplied a7772d4/b03173f hardware trials had raw_recording unset and external ROSbag2+SQLite3; they do not exercise this path. VmHWM RSS is not anonymous-only RSS or aggregate camera/container memory.
peak_method: Linux child VmHWM sampled immediately after writer finish, before the independent post-timer materialized readback; includes driver/one reusable producer pixel buffer and all process resident memory.
